attributes.name: Druva - Privileged Role Removal
attributes.description: Detects privileged role removal in Druva Data Security Cloud events.
author: Druva

meta.customer_usecase: Detects privileged role removal in Druva Data Security Cloud events.

attributes.query:
FROM logs-druva.event-*
| WHERE TO_LOWER(COALESCE(message, "")) LIKE "*role*remov*"
| KEEP @timestamp, event.id, event.action, event.outcome, event.severity, druva.feature, druva.event_type, user.name, user.email, source.ip, druva.resource.name, message
| SORT @timestamp DESC
| LIMIT 100
